purpose: Preregistered candidate-only microcategory and query-input study; no Audit selection

screening.unit: normalized query text; every context of a selected text is retained

full_tune_followup.role: Exploratory follow-up on every 6111 Tune text, not an independent holdout
full_tune_followup.selection_rule: Take best non-control candidate Recall within family A and family B, best practical fill, and best alternate dense replacement; retain each family's declared control for direct full-Tune comparison. Ties within 1e-12 choose smaller average realized pool, then lexicographic variant name. A selected hypothesis may still lose to its control and must be reported as such.
full_tune_followup.audit_rule: Do not open or score the completed Audit arm to select variants or change retrieval/model settings

inference.candidate_metric: Candidate Recall is the pool upper bound; no new-pool reranker Recall@50 is computed

bootstrap.interval: percentile 95%; exploratory and uncorrected for hypothesis-grid selection

derived_from_screen.selection_rule: Take best non-control candidate Recall within family A and family B, best practical fill, and best alternate dense replacement; retain each family's declared control for direct full-Tune comparison. Ties within 1e-12 choose smaller average realized pool, then lexicographic variant name. A selected hypothesis may still lose to its control and must be reported as such.
derived_from_screen.matched_addition_caveat: Control+winner families match per-group additions across two retained systems; screen minima used four members. Full-Tune additions may rise while equal-size matching and177-cap remain.
derived_from_screen.query_alternate_note: Best alternate still trails current on screen; retain comparison as declared, not adoption.
